string.text: Ghillie Wrap

A ghillie suit cut down into a loose wrap of netting and burlap strips that hangs over whatever armor you already wear. It offers no protection, but breaks up your outline so human eyes slide past you, as long as you keep still or move slowly. Takes one attachment belt slot.\n\nCan't be attached over an exoskeleton: there is no hiding a powered frame under burlap.
